service.method: SELECT SETL.SMR_NUMBER , SETL.SMR_STATUS , SETL.ADD_USER_ID , USMT.EMAIL , USMT.DEPT , SETL.ADD_DATE , SETL.ADD_TIME , SETL.APPLY_TYPE , SETL.SUBJECT AS DOC_SUBJECT , SETL.EXT_OUT_EXPECT_DATE , SETL.EXT_OUT_EXPECT_TIME , SETL.EXT_IN_EXPECT_DATE , SETL.EXT_IN_EXPECT_TIME , DATEDIFF(DAY, SETL.EXT_IN_EXPECT_DATE, GETDATE()) AS COUNT_DAY FROM SSETL SETL INNER JOIN SUSMT USMT ON SETL.HOUSE_CODE = USMT.HOUSE_CODE AND SETL.COMPANY_CODE = USMT.COMPANY_CODE AND SETL.ADD_USER_ID = USMT.USER_ID WHERE SETL.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND SETL.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND SETL.DEL_FLAG ='N' AND SMR_STATUS = 'RW' AND DATEDIFF(DAY, SETL.EXT_IN_EXPECT_DATE, GETDATE()) >= #{COUNT_DAY} ORDER BY SMR_NUMBER DESC
